Overview

Rome is a city in GA with a population of 37,000. Historic Northwest Georgia city with Berry College, seven hills, and riverfront charm. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
